cohort: Women in the Netherlands with an intention to deliver vaginally a term, cephalic, singleton between 2000 and 2009 (n=1,378,458)
finding: Despite a near triplication in epidural analgesia use over a 10-year period, rates of operative deliveries remained relatively stable, and the association between epidural analgesia and operative delivery weakened.
mod_finding: The association between epidural analgesia and both caesarean section and instrumental vaginal delivery weakened over the 10-year study period.
